title: CLTR Cutover HumanAuthorization record
description: Phase 136N, Implementation Group 4. Shape-only wire contract for a HumanAuthorization companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.21). A HumanAuthorization document represents a principal's decision to permit a specific, scoped cutover attempt to proceed; it never itself proves a real human actually made that decision, proves signer identity, proves proof/signature validity, establishes replay/freshness truth, certifies anything, publishes authority, executes cutover, or establishes current authority (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. Tier 1 (strict): additionalProperties: false, no _extensions escape hatch (Sec.14). authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden (Sec.9's 12-file list includes human_authorization). Scope is bound structurally by request_reference + readiness_reference + target_reference (all three required, all family-restricted, cross-family schema_id/schema_version required per Sec.12) -- no separate wildcard-capable 'scope' string/enum field exists anywhere in Sec.21's frozen field table, and none is invented here (disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136N-4, since the Phase 136 implementation plan Sec.13 Group 4 test list uses the word 'scope' informally to describe this same three-reference binding, not a distinct field).

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the HumanAuthorization schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

phase_id.description: Always present. human_authorization is one of the families requiring phase_id (Sec.7.2).

migration_epoch.description: Always present. Every companion record binds to exactly one migration epoch (Sec.7.2, CSCH-INV-1).

principal.description: Always present. Non-secret principal identifier; used only on this family (Sec.6.1). Does not verify the principal against any identity provider or authentication system (Layer 4/6).

method.description: Always present. AuthorizationMethod (Sec.21). proof_reference is required when this is 'signed_attestation' and forbidden when this is 'manual_review' (enforced below) -- a locally-decided conditional filling a Sec.21/Sec.16 cross-reference gap Sec.16's own table does not spell out, disclosed as NON-BLOCKING-136N-5 (same category as 136L's NON-BLOCKING-136L-1/2 disclosed field-gap fills).

request_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference, with schema_id/schema_version required per Sec.12's cross-family-reference rule, to the CutoverRequest this authorization scopes to. A valid reference never implies the referenced request exists or matches (Layer 4).

readiness_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference, with schema_id/schema_version required, to the ReadinessPackage this authorization scopes to. A valid reference never implies the referenced package exists, matches, or is itself ready (Layer 4).

target_reference.description: Always present. Family-tagged reference, with schema_id/schema_version required, to the proposed target AuthorityEpoch this authorization scopes to. A valid reference never implies the referenced epoch exists or is active (Layer 4/6).

issued_at.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never compared against expires_at or wall-clock 'now' at Layer 2 (Layer 4/5).

expires_at.description: Always present, not optional -- restates CLTR-CUTOVER-001 Sec.8's 24-hour freshness window as a mandatory field (Sec.21). The actual freshness comparison against wall-clock 'now' is Layer 4/5; this schema only requires the field exist and be shape-valid.

state.description: Always present. Record-local AuthorizationState (Sec.8.8, 4 values). 'used' requires use_binding; 'revoked' requires revocation_metadata (both enforced below, Sec.16). A schema-valid state here never itself proves current freshness, actual revocation truth, or actual prior use (Layer 4/5).

revocation_metadata.description: Conditionally present: required when state is 'revoked', forbidden otherwise (Sec.16 row 4).

use_binding.description: Conditionally present: required when state is 'used', forbidden otherwise (Sec.16 row 5). A forward-shaped reference to the publication_attempt record that consumed this authorization -- publication_attempt.schema.json is not implemented in this phase (Group 5); this field is a shape-only forward reference and does not require the referenced document to already exist for schema validity (matching the 136J authority_state.publication_evidence_reference precedent).

replay_binding.description: Always present. Opaque one-time-use token *reference* only (Sec.21, Sec.25, Sec.26) -- never the secret/token value itself. Shape alone cannot prove the referenced token has not been replayed; that is Layer 4/5 (Sec.25 replay/freshness boundary).

risk_acknowledgement.description: Always present. const true (Sec.21) -- an authorization document that does not acknowledge risk is not schema-valid. Does not itself prove the principal actually reviewed or understood the risk (Layer 4).

proof_reference.description: Conditionally present: required when method is 'signed_attestation', forbidden when method is 'manual_review' (enforced below). Opaque, hashed, non-reusable pointer to a proof artifact stored elsewhere -- never a raw signature blob, bearer token, password, or private key (Sec.26). Schema validity of a well-formed reference never itself proves cryptographic validity or signer authenticity (Sec.1, Sec.25).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role 'authoritative' is locally forbidden on this record (Sec.9's 12-file list); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless. A valid HumanAuthorization record never itself authorizes or executes anything -- it is governance evidence of a recorded decision only.

request_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'cutover_request', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).

readiness_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'readiness_package', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).

target_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'authority_epoch', with schema_id/schema_version unconditionally required (Sec.12 cross-family rule).

use_binding.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family 'publication_attempt' -- a forward reference to a family whose own schema file is not implemented until Group 5.

revoked_at.description: Always present when this object is present.

revoked_by.description: Always present when this object is present. The principal who revoked this authorization; may differ from the original issuing principal.

reason_code.description: Always present when this object is present.

revocation_metadata.description: Bounded local revocation-disclosure object (Sec.16 row 4). Present only when state is 'revoked'.
